independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG3 implementation, test, register row or ADR in the reviewed candidate, including the round-4 repair T-DG3-KBE-F. I formed this verdict from my own runs in a complete (non-shallow) disposable clone of the freeze commit fd27c10 (source 171a0b57). I used my own probes from round 3, with only the round label and evidence path changed: dg3-api, dg3-api-extra, dg3-ui-world, dg3-ui, dg3-ui-inherited, dg3-ui-overflow and dg3-ui-overflow-r3. I read the repair diff only to understand the change. I did not open any other reviewer's round-4 record or evidence.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment hash, HEAD and its relation to source_commit. Recompute the candidate ID in the repository and in a complete disposable clone, before and after the runs.
checks_run.command: sha256sum <assignment>; git rev-parse HEAD; git merge-base --is-ancestor 171a0b57 HEAD; git diff --name-only 171a0b57..HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG3 (repo and clone); git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository
checks_run.environment: Node 24.21.0; repository at fd27c10; clone under $TMPDIR (removed afterwards)
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:8376d762…fc455 over 757 files in both trees. Freeze HEAD differs from source only by delivery records.
checks_run.actual: The assignment hash matches (d7c6d773…). HEAD is fd27c10, the freeze commit faabb77 plus a progress.md wording commit. source_commit 171a0b57 is an ancestor, and the only files changed since it are the three round-4 assignments, the candidate manifest, progress.md and stages.json, none of them in the manifest. The candidate ID is sha256:8376d762920591f1348e321dc36aaa806793efe2238af113f903b76b016fc455 with 757 files in the repository and in the clone, both before and after the runs. The clone is not shallow. The installed lockfile is byte-identical to pnpm-lock.yaml.

checks_run.procedure: Run the three validators the assignment requires.
checks_run.command: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG3; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1
checks_run.actual: 'PASS register rules at DG3', 'PASS gate DG2 (historical)' and 'PASS gate DG1 (historical)', each with exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: In the clone, run typecheck, build, lint, the unit tests (pnpm test: unit-node + unit-web, then unit-formula-nocodegen) and the contrast check, on Node 22 and on Node 24.
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 (/opt/node22/bin) and Node 24.21.0; clone at fd27c10
checks_run.expected: All exit 0 on both versions. Every skip or warning is explained.
checks_run.actual: Every step exits 0 on both versions. pnpm test: 81 files, 1593/1593 passed (unit-node + unit-web), then 3 files, 199 passed and 1 skipped of 200 (unit-formula-nocodegen). Disclosures: (1) The ONE skipped test is fuzz.test.ts 'every file of the engine's import closure gets the engine-source lint rules', declared it.skipIf(NOCODEGEN). ESLint compiles its rule schemas with ajv (new Function), so it cannot run under --disallow-code-generation-from-strings. The same test RAN and passed in unit-node (fuzz.test.ts 50/50 in unit-node on both versions). This is the documented exception in ADR-0024 §6, not a failure. (2) build logs carry Vite's 'Some chunks are larger than 500 kB' advisory for apps/web, the same as rounds 1–3. It is a size notice, not an error. (3) The contrast logs' 'error' matches are token names (feedback.error.*) on PASS lines. Lint runs with --max-warnings=0 and exits 0. No failed, flaky or timed-out test.

checks_run.procedure: Inspect git diff ce988e20..171a0b57 outside docs/delivery. Classify every changed line of the engine's non-test sources. Confirm no API, web, DB, shared-schema or i18n file changed.
checks_run.expected: T-DG3-KBE-F only: an EvalError rethrow in the engine's catches, value.ts under the formula lint rules, tests, and ADR-0024 §6 / p3-work-split text. No formula semantics change.
checks_run.actual: 9 files: ADR-0024, p3-work-split.md (amendment 26), eslint.config.js, packages/shared/src/formula/{evaluate.ts, index.ts, formula.test.ts, fuzz.test.ts, codegen.nocodegen.test.ts} and packages/shared/src/value.ts. The only behavioural lines in non-test sources are four 'if (e instanceof EvalError) throw e;' statements: validateFormula, evaluateFormula, evaluateAst's walk catch and formatDecimal's catch, which became 'catch (e)'. Everything else is comments. No tokenizer, parser, type checker, period/unit/fraction rule, rounding or decimal code changed, and no apps/**, packages/db, shared schema or i18n file changed. eslint.config.js adds FORMULA_CLOSURE_OUTSIDE = [value.ts] to the two formula blocks, with a decimal.js-only import allowlist. Domain reading: an EvalError cannot arise from a user formula, so user-facing semantics are unchanged. Any other unexpected error is still a 422 formula.syntax 'internal' problem, or Unknown (null) in formatDecimal, never zero. The ADR text states this honestly and makes no stronger claim. The live results confirm it (DOM-R4-07): 100000 SAR exact, cost 500000, monthly × annual refused.

checks_run.expected: The same pass set as round 3 (12/12 and 155/155). The badge stays inside the card and row, with no horizontal page scroll, in EN and AR.
checks_run.actual: dg3-ui-overflow 12/12 PASS and dg3-ui-overflow-r3 155/155 PASS, exit 0. The set of PASS ids is identical to round 3. Example: at AR 1366 the badge spans [747,1056] inside the card [734,1069], docScroll 1366 = viewport. At AR 390 the screenshot shows the badge text wrapping inside the G1 card, with G1 'لم تُقدَّم' (not submitted). No error line in either log.

checks_run.procedure: Re-run the inherited-approval API probe. It walks one dispensation through none, pending, accepted, accepted-unverified, re-verified, revoked and rejected, plus End-to-End and waiver cases. At each state it checks the inheritedApproval annotation (status, counts), G1 in the list and the view, and the gate_submission/gate_decision rows.
checks_run.expected: 33/33 as in round 3. counts is true only when the record is accepted with verified evidence by a different holder of gate.decide. G1 stays draft with 0 submissions and 0 decisions in every state.
checks_run.actual: 33/33 PASS, exit 0, with the same ids as round 3. The annotation is pending_verification/false, then accepted/true, accepted/false once the evidence is unverified, accepted/true again, then revoked/false and rejected/false. In every state G1 is draft, approvedAt null, latestSubmissionNo 0, with 0 gate_submission and 0 gate_decision rows. The recorder cannot accept (403), and acceptance on someone else's behalf is refused (422). End-to-End refuses an inherited approval (422 dispensation.inherited_requires_modular). A waiver never approves and never shows as inheritedApproval. A baseline edit makes the Finance validation stale. A missing cost is Unknown (null), never 0.

checks_run.procedure: Re-run the inherited-approval UI probe in EN and AR: gates list, gate view, readiness and dispensations, for each annotation state.
checks_run.expected: 94/94 as in round 3. The badge text matches the state, G1 always reads 'Not submitted' / 'لم تُقدَّم', and the approval is never fabricated.
checks_run.actual: 94/94 PASS, exit 0, with the same ids as round 3. The screenshots show the 'counts in sequencing (does not approve this gate)' wording, G1 not submitted and '0 of 6 mandatory outputs complete', in EN and AR.

checks_run.procedure: Re-run the full live API probe of the P3 operating logic. It covers T05–T09, the business case, sequencing, structure, selection and G4, all with SYNTHETIC data. Compare the PASS ids with round 3.
checks_run.expected: 139/139 with the same ids as round 3. Each acceptance text in the register holds literally.
checks_run.actual: 139/139 PASS, exit 0, with the same ids as round 3. Highlights: T05 3–7 deliverables is a warning, never a rejection (2 and 8 warn, 3 and 5 do not), and the narrative fields round-trip. T06: 5-4-3-2-1 gives 3.3000 (displayed 3.30) under v1 25/25/20/15/15, with display100 57.5 and the label '(weighted score − 1) ÷ 4 × 100'. A missing score is incomplete, never 0. Weights of 95% or 105% are refused, the proposer cannot approve, v2 gives 3.2000, and history names 'weight version 2'. An override needs a reason and Sponsor approval. T07: the four B0079 waves are verbatim and immutable, and overlap is accepted. T08: seven columns, From can be External, and cycles are named. T09: six columns. The attach rate 0.10→0.12 × 100000 × ARPU 50 SAR gives '100000' exactly (rounded false), the delta is 0.02 pp (fraction_delta), the cost example gives 500000, monthly × annual gives 422 formula.period_mismatch, and an explicit to_period is accepted. Business case: the ten B0085 sections persist, there is one class per line (two classes give 400), class/kind and value-basis mismatches give 422, and a formula linked twice gives 409. Revenue and margin are separate with a warning, avoided cost is not cash, the roll-up goes 650000→660000 with no duplication, and net value is separate. Finance validation: an author cannot validate (403), and Finance cannot author (SoD). Sequencing: submitting before G1 gives 422 with the B0011/B0012 text, G1 approval needs the three agreements, 'Outcome before activity' is enforced, End-to-End launch is refused until G2 and G3, and a Modular inherited approval counts only when verified and accepted by another person, with G1 still draft and no decision. Structure: the five levels are in one tree, and an initiative is refused as TOM evidence. Selection: ranking never funds, and 'Selected - unfunded' cannot launch. Capacity: over_allocated with shortfall 0.50, a missing capacity row is Unknown, and the TL lacks capacity.commit. G4: 422 gate_criteria_incomplete naming 'Owners: INI-02 …', 'Finance validation' and the initiatives. Observation, unchanged since round 1 and not a defect: the API detail for g4.finance_validation repeats the word 'Finance validation' once per missing item without the item names. The UI names each item (DOM-R4-08).

Take a screenshot of each.

The EN G4 view lists Owners, Finance validation, Funding and Capacity with the initiative linked, says 'it never approves anything itself', and shows the 'Provisional' wordmark marker. The AR T09 revenue formula shows 100,000.00 SAR per year with 'Instantiated from the B0087 example … (illustrative calculation, synthetic values)'.

summary: PASS. The candidate ID was recomputed on a complete clone: 8376d762…, 757 files. The KBE-F repair adds only four EvalError rethrows (plus comments) to the engine and value.ts, lint scope, tests and ADR text, so formula semantics are unchanged: 100000 SAR exact, cost 500000, monthly × annual refused. F-DG3-120 still holds (33/33, 94/94: annotation states and counts correct, G1 stays draft with no decision). F-DG3-170 still holds (12/12, 155/155: the badge wraps inside its card and row in EN and AR). The full domain probes are unchanged from round 3 (API 139/139, UI 42/42, with the same ids). Unit tests pass on Node 22 and 24 (1593 + 199 passed, 1 documented skip), the targeted integration suites pass (156), and the validators pass. No new finding.
